John and Tim first chatted on 21 May 2023. They are friendly and encourage each other.

**Tim**
- Harry Potter fan; the books and films offer escape from daily life. Keeps Harry Potter reminders and may visit more related places. Has not yet visited real-world Harry Potter sites.
- Developed a Harry Potter fan project with a fan friend during the week of 14–20 May 2023; it would cover characters, spells, and magical creatures. Likes seeing fans come together.
- Joined a fantasy-literature forum in May 2023 and found an online magazine there. Pitched ideas that the magazine liked; writes fantasy-novel articles on characters, themes, and book recommendations. Writing combines reading with sharing stories. Especially likes writing about Harry Potter and Game of Thrones.
- Took a memorable Harry Potter-related London tour a few years before May 2023; it felt like stepping into a movie and he offered John tips. In July 2023 attended an unspecified fan event, one of his favorite experiences of belonging: people shared and understood his interests. Attended other fan events too.
- Spoke with a Harry Potter fan in California in July 2023; Skyped on 9 August to discuss characters and possible collaboration.
- Enjoys fantasy reading, especially Patrick Rothfuss’s *The Name of the Wind* (world-building and character development; protagonist is a magician and musician). Began learning piano by 21 August 2023; enjoys different songs and especially a Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone theme, which recalls cozy family movie time.
- Likes traveling and experiencing the “magic” of new places. Had long wanted to visit New York City; after John’s recommendation added it to his travel list and John offered help planning.
- Never played on a sports team; prefers books and magical worlds.
- Family traditions: Thanksgiving feast, sharing what they’re thankful for, then movies. Favorites include *Home Alone* (brings laughter), *Elf* (family watches it during holidays; funny and festive), and *The Santa Clause* (heartwarming and festive). Family meals mean a lot to him; described one as full of love and laughter.
- 26 August 2023: stressed by assignments and exams but determined to persevere, balancing study with fantasy reading. Shared a book stack and bookshelf with books and clock.
- 31 August 2023: was rejected for a summer job but staying positive; gave a class presentation on 30 August despite nerves and felt it was progress. Planned first visit to Universal Studios for September 2023, excited about Harry Potter attractions; had never been before.

**John**
- Basketball shooting guard; signed with the Minnesota Wolves before their season opener in late May 2023. On 21 May said things were going well, teammates were nice, and he was having fun. Preseason adjustment to team style was challenging. Goal then was improving shooting percentage.
- Loves talking with people about his sneaker collection. Enjoys stadium games’ excitement and shared atmosphere of cheering fans. Has never visited Harry Potter-related places, but it’s on his to-do list.
- Scored a personal-best 40 points in a tough game in the week before 16 July 2023; teammates celebrated at a restaurant. Calls teammates a second family. On 9 August made the winning final basket in a close game and said teammates support him on and off court.
- Signed a Nike basketball shoe/gear deal; likes Under Armour and would like to work with them. On 15 June was exploring endorsements, considering Nike and Under Armour, open to aligned brands, and had not yet chosen.
- Loved Seattle’s energy, diversity, food, seafood (especially crab), ocean, and supportive fans; looked forward to an August game there. Surfed with friends in summer 2023; started around 2018 and loves nature, freedom, and excitement. Visited Chicago before 11 August, enjoying its energy, friendly people, and cultural variety. Enjoys discovering cities, exploring, and trying restaurants.
- Basketball dream began watching the NBA with his dad; at 10 his dad enrolled him in a local league. Played through school, earned a college scholarship, and was drafted. Biggest goal is a championship; off court hopes to give back and inspire. Worked with a local organization supporting disadvantaged children through sports and school.
- On 2 August 2023 said an inspiring book reminded him to keep dreaming and reaching for goals. He and Anthony attended a charity event and Harry Potter trivia; a “super-nerd” won.
- On 21 August found a new gym with basketball court for fitness and professional training. Schedule combines basketball and strength training; trial and error, listening to his body, and rest help him balance it. Strength work builds muscle, power, explosiveness, athleticism, and injury prevention; he said it improved shooting accuracy, agility, speed, and confidence. Shared workout-plan notebook.
- Lucky basketball shoes symbolize resilience, determination, love of basketball, achievements, and progress; they’ve accompanied him through successes, failures, and friendships.
- 31 August 2023: said NYC trip went okay; initially struggled with the subway, then someone explained it and it became easy. Tried cooking recipes and improvised a tasty soup with sage; had no written recipe.

**Shared photos and dated conversation details**
- **21 May 2023:** John shared jerseys on a bed, two men by a basketball machine, locker-room bench/lockers, shoes arranged in a circle, and a bookcase with books/toys. Tim shared a basketball game in progress and a table of books. John said he was practicing hard to improve shooting percentage.
- **15 June 2023:** Tim shared bookshelf and MinaLima picture; said MinaLima made all Harry Potter film props. John shared a gym game photo and said playing felt awesome.
- **16 July 2023:** John shared scoreboard/phone, teammates, people eating, jerseys in a store, handwritten letter, basketball card, mannequin in blue suit, Seattle sunset skyline, crowd, crab meal, beach/surf scenes and surfer. He had only one photo from the basketball game, showing action in a large arena. Tim shared books, a Harry Potter-covered book, and living room with brown couch and white ottoman.
- **2 August 2023:** Tim described his magazine articles. John shared an inspiring book photo, with someone holding a bookmark; he was reading it to keep dreaming and pursue goals.
- **9 August 2023:** John shared an arena photo after the game-winning basket.
- **11 August 2023:** Tim shared an open book page and a photo of the three-book *Name of the Wind* set. John shared lucky shoes in a box; their wear reminded him of resilience, memories, and progress.
- **17 August 2023:** John shared a basketball signed by teammates, symbolizing friendship, support, and his journey.
- **21 August 2023:** Tim discussed school, fantasy reading, piano, and family traditions. John shared workout plan and a DVD cover of a castle scene, saying he owned the complete Harry Potter collection. They reminisced about family movie time. Tim shared a family meal and *Home Alone*, *Elf*, and *The Santa Clause* DVD covers; John shared a group at a kitchen table and his lit Christmas tree from the previous year. Tim shared his own Harry Potter-themed tree, which he decorated. Ended warmly.
- **26 August 2023:** John had visited home the previous week, catching up with family and old friends and reminiscing about childhood. Shared a group photo of girls’ basketball players; they had been his high-school teammates for four years. Also shared NYC skyline/skyscraper photo. Tim admired the squad, shared bookshelf photo, and thanked John for his support.
- **31 August 2023:** John shared a bowl of soup, spoon, and butternut on a cutting board. Tim said he liked experimenting with spices and planned to look up a recipe.
